alt: 店主把難得的手工作品收在櫃內，面對想買的人仍暫不出售，等待更高的出價。
scene_prompt: 奇貨可居 means holding a rare sought-after item to wait for a high price. Modern small artisan collectors' shop. Owner holds a beautiful unique unbranded handmade ceramic bird safely behind a glass display cabinet, one hand protectively closing the cabinet and the other making a patient 'wait' gesture. Several eager adult collectors outside the counter offer small plain coin purses and point at the rare bird, but the owner looks calculating and withholds the item while imagining a larger pile of plain coins in a small thought bubble. Nearby shelves hold ordinary cups, making this singular intricate bird the scarce special object. No readable price tags, currencies, text, logos, famous collectible designs or auction brands.
